name: Card-header-lockup
purpose: The header zone of a Cards surface — title, an optional meta line, and either inline ghost actions or a single overflow trigger that opens an actions menu — kept separate from Cards' four full card types because a header zone recurs inside many different card bodies. Composed ENTIRELY from Cards, Icon-button, Status-indicator and Dropdown's floating-panel CSS (with a declared ARIA deviation from listbox to menu). Itinerary row 117 (Layer 2, NO-ARTEFACT-CLASS at mint; PROPOSED here, not ruled).

props.name: arrangement
props.$note: Three arrangement variants: A title+meta only, B title+meta+two inline ghost actions (Cards' .qbtn), C title+meta+status chip+overflow menu. VARIANTS-axis prop (s142-D1 class C6).

variants.name: plain
variants.use: A static card header with no interactive affordance — read-only summary cards.

variants.name: inline-actions
variants.use: Two lightweight actions always visible (e.g. Edit / Pause on a standing order).

variants.name: status-overflow
variants.use: A verification/status chip plus a menu of less-frequent actions behind one overflow trigger — keeps the header from crowding as the action list grows.

tokens.surface: tertiary/background/default + border/subtle + border-radius/surface (the Cards recipe, unmodified)
tokens.title: canon/type.css .t-cm-ctl-16 composite
tokens.status-chip: rag/success-tint + rag/success via Status-indicator.reference.html's tint-chip form B, unmodified
tokens.menu-panel: background/default + elevation/border + elevation/functional via Dropdown.reference.html's .menu/.opt positioning CSS, ARIA role changed from listbox to menu (declared deviation, see the snippet's own header)
tokens.$note: Every token above resolves through the ATOM's own manifest; this organism binds nothing new.

responsive.$status: PROPOSED at #210 wave-6 (not ruled) — reflow verified in a real browser at 3 widths.
responsive.rule: The header row is a CONTAINER QUERY on the `.card` surface itself (container-type:inline-size), collapsing the title/meta above the actions row below a 280px container — the query element (.card) and the measured element (.ch-actions) are DIFFERENT elements, avoiding the self-query trap.
responsive.$note: s210-D3 discipline: the card's own width comes from its consuming grid/board, not from this file.

livesInside: Cards (any of the four gated types, as the header zone)
commonPatterns: verified-payee card with an overflow menu

accessibility.structure: Title is an <h3> (a card is a subsection of its page, never the page's own heading level); the overflow trigger carries aria-haspopup="menu" + aria-expanded + aria-controls; the panel carries role="menu" with role="menuitem" buttons (declared deviation from Dropdown's role="listbox"/role="option", see the snippet header).
accessibility.focus: The overflow trigger keeps Icon-button's own :focus-visible ring; menu items keep Dropdown's own :focus-visible ring, unmodified; focus returns to the trigger on menu close (Escape or item activation).

antiPatterns: Re-drawing the card surface, the icon-button or the menu panel instead of composing the existing atom
Reusing Dropdown's role="listbox"/aria-selected for an ACTIONS menu (this is a selection widget's ARIA on a non-selection widget — the declared deviation exists precisely to avoid this)
More than one overflow trigger per card header
A container-type declared on the wrong element (the query MUST live on .card, not on .ch-actions itself — WAVE-5 LESSON 3)
